title: [Pricing] Percentage coupon is calculated on subtotal plus delivery fee, so customers are undercharged
summary: Applying a percentage coupon discounts the delivery fee as well as the items. With SAVE20 on a 180 AED cart plus a 20 AED delivery fee, the discount is 40 AED instead of 36 AED and the total is 160.00 AED instead of 164.00 AED. Severity is major: every percentage-coupon order is undercharged, which is direct revenue loss, but checkout still works. Priority is P2 because coupons are live in production campaigns; raise it to P1 if a campaign launches before the fix.
steps_to_reproduce: Add 2 x Wireless Mouse (90 AED each) to the cart
Go to checkout as a guest
Enter the coupon code SAVE20 and click Apply
Check the discount line and the total in the order summary
Place the order and check the API response for POST /orders
expected_result: Discount = 20% of the item subtotal (180.00) = 36.00 AED. Total = 180.00 - 36.00 + 20.00 = 164.00 AED.
actual_result: The discount is 40.00 AED and the total is 160.00 AED, in both the UI and the API response (ord-20931).
evidence: screenshot.png: the order summary shows '- AED 40.00' and a total of AED 160.00
checkout-service.log 11:02:19: pricing-service WARN 'discount base resolved from cart.total (200.00) instead of cart.subtotal', requestId req-91d0aa31
suspected_root_cause: The pricing service uses cart.total (which includes delivery) as the discount base instead of cart.subtotal.
open_questions: Does it also affect logged-in users and the mobile app?
Since which build? Was it introduced by the latest pricing change?
Are orders already placed in production affected, and does Finance need a list?
